meta.title: Test suite: eliminate real time waits
meta.body_summary: Eliminate real-time waits in test suites for digital garage and consent management utilities by shortening timeouts and using Jest fake timers.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex shortened timeouts and used fake timers in test suite to eliminate real time waits; merged promptly with single approval and no review text.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: The raw change count of 32,002 lines is dominated by a merge of master (e.g., 21,858-line package-lock.json diff), not the performance fix itself. The actual test suite changes are small: ~94 lines across 4 test files (cmUtils_spec.js, dgkeywordRtdProvider_spec.js, instreamTracking_spec.js, yieldoneAnalyticsAdapter_spec.js), reducing real-time waits via shorter timeouts and fake timers. This tiny, low-risk maintenance change merged quickly without discussion.

review_details.performance_claim: Eliminate real-time waits in test suites for digital garage and consent management utils, thereby reducing test execution time.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple test-suite refactoring to use fake timers and reduce timeouts; well within agent capabilities for test maintenance tasks.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after timing or test suite runtime evidence provided; only claim that real-time waits existed.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression reported; merge proceeded without issues.

core_change_summary.description: In test files, shortened a timeout in dgkeywordRtdProvider_spec.js and cmUtils_spec.js, and replaced real-time setTimeout-based waits with Jest fake timers (jest.useFakeTimers) in instreamTracking_spec.js and yieldoneAnalyticsAdapter_spec.js to eliminate actual delays during test execution.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The massive file count and line churn come from merging master (commit 6dbdce) and an unrelated pull request (commit 04606ee); the actual performance-relevant changes are confined to the 4 test files above.
change_trajectory: First commit (a55e2ac): shortened dgkeywordRtd timeout in cmUtils_spec.js and dgkeywordRtdProvider_spec.js.
Second commit (6dbdce): merged latest master (introduces many unrelated changes).
Third commit (86991cd): added fake timers to instreamTracking_spec.js and yieldoneAnalyticsAdapter_spec.js.
Fourth commit (04606ee): merged a branch containing the fake-timers change.

review_signals.summary: Approved the PR without any review comments.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by patmmccann with two test improvements (timeout reduction and fake timers).
Approved by ChrisHuie approximately 58 minutes later with no review comments.
Merged by ChrisHuie about 59 minutes after creation.
